articles.question: How do I run and interpret an embargo screening?
articles.answer: View automatic embargo and sanctions screening findings directly on the shipment page, which runs automatically whenever documents are uploaded or shipment fields are modified.
steps: Navigate to the shipment details workspace.
Locate the Automatic Embargo & Sanctions Screening panel.
Check the status badge for Clear, Attention, Blocked, or Not yet run states.
Review detailed findings listed per line item, including origin, destination, and private embargo rule checks.

articles.question: How do I review or correct extracted document fields?
articles.answer: Review and verify extracted document fields in the Document Review Panel or field review modal, edit unconfirmed or missing values, and clear document reconciliation conflicts directly against the document source.
steps: Open the document in the Document Review Panel from the shipment workspace or Documents tab.
Inspect fields flagged with review warnings, missing values, or cross-document conflicts.
Click any field to highlight its bounding box and source page location on the document canvas.
Approve correct values or enter updated values for fields requiring human correction.
Resolve cross-document reconciliation conflicts directly from the document field review list.
